content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The solution is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure stack. COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce stack, giving you full control over your online store, payment processing, and product delivery. With a stack based on open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, you can deploy a fully operational online store in 48 hours. This means no more platform fees, no more payment rejections, and complete data ownership. The impact is significant: at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference is $921, a substantial improvement over Gumroad's 10% charge.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure stack consists of several key components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your online store, providing a scalable and secure platform for your digital products. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, streamlining tasks like order management and payment processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, keeping your data safe and organized. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files, ensuring seamless product distribution. Finally, NOWPayments integrates with your stack, providing automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This architecture enables you to collect payments directly from customers, bypassing Stripe and other platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. This includes creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. By providing a base-layer infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers these creators to take control of their online sales, reducing fees and increasing revenue. With a stack that's easy to deploy and manage, even those with limited technical expertise can benefit from this solution.
With COREMERCH, you can sell digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of the COREMERCH stack are GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a scalable and secure hosting platform for your online store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, streamlining tasks like order management and payment processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, keeping your data safe and organized. Finally, NOWPayments integrates with your stack, providing automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. By combining these components, you can create a fully operational online store that meets your needs.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using COREMERCH, follow these steps. First, choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic. Select a database, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, to store orders. Finally, integrate NOWPayments into your stack to enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can reduce fees and increase revenue.
